RSI at 63.7 is cooling from overbought territory, and MACD histogram worsened to 0.0034, indicating weakening buying momentum. Volume is also subdued at 0.53 relative to the 5-day average, showing a lack of direction. The 52-week position at 15.0% remains low, but resistance is confirmed around the 5-day high of $0.26 and swing support at $0.25. The current price of $0.25 aligns with SMA5, entering a sideways consolidation phase. No clear buy/sell signals warrant maintaining a cautious stance.
